title: SMS status shows Batt: null% with Omnipod Dash
body: Description: After successfully setting a TBR via SMS (0.00 U/h for 120 min), the confirmation message shows an invalid battery value: Batt: null% All other status fields are correct. Environment: AAPS 3.3.3.0-dev Omnipod Dash SMS control enabled Expected: Valid battery percentage or no battery field if unavailable. Actual: Batt: null% is shown in SMS status.
